points.label: Spirit’s role
points.left: John says he needs baptism from Jesus, then consents; Jesus rises from the water as Spirit and heavenly voice appear.
points.right: John calls Jesus the Lamb of God, recalls why he baptized, says he did not recognize him, and names the descending and remaining Spirit as the given sign.
